source: hand-written for the companion-lanes proof (task 3): seven lines, seven emotions, four gestures; p/b/m plosives and round vowels in every line

c1.line: Hi hi hi! Welcome back, bunnies! Big plans, big snacks, big boss fight tonight!

c2.line: Five hundred bits?! Boba, you beautiful person! The pom pom emote is yours, I promise!

c3.line: Mid?! Mid?! I beat that boss with one pixel of health and you call it mid?

c4.line: Um. Maybe the bonus round was moved to tomorrow. On purpose. Probably.

c5.line: Wow. Okay. The ears get all the love. I am just the person under them, I suppose.

c6.line: No clipping the pout! Mods, please, I beg you, my reputation is on the line.

c7.line: You believe in me? Okay, boom, mood fixed. Rematch! Bunnies, pump it up!
